policy.name: 방범대장
notes: All amounts, the 99-row growth curve and zero-XP initialization are local test proposals, not production balance approval.
Main quests alone: 21 x 200 = 4200 XP, level 43. Main plus the existing four resident stories: 6000 XP, level 61.
Quest-linked adventure returns award zero commander XP because the quest completion is the same account reward event. Required adventures are still played.
No proposed twelve resident stories are implemented. No historical player XP is reconstructed from unit XP.
At the last configured threshold, keep the lifetime total and display curve extension pending; this is not a spendable balance or a promised future-level reward.
